wiki.title: Deborah Fellela
wiki.extract: Deborah A. Fellela (born November 16, 1956) is an American politician and a Democratic member of the Rhode Island House of Representatives representing District 43 since January 2007. Fellela serves as a Deputy Majority Leader of her caucus. Outside her work in government, Fellela works as the secretary to the principal of Robert F. Kennedy Elementary School.
